name: Wrench & Rodent Seabasstropub
menu_notes: Live Toast ordering page (source_url) and seabasstropub.com/menu both blocked fetches; fell back to Yelp's cached menu page. 9-10 of 10 checked dishes exist there by name (Baked Scallops, Cucumber Salad, Power Bowl, Anchovy Nigiri, Chronic, Avocado Roll, Cucumber Roll, Hedgehog all present, Roasted Cauliflower ~ Yelp's 'Crispy Cauliflower'), but Yelp's prices run 30-100% lower across the board (e.g. Chronic $13 vs our $22, Hedgehog $14 vs our $23, Cucumber Roll $3 vs our $6), consistent with Yelp showing a stale/older snapshot rather than the live Toast menu our data was sourced from. Only Anchovy Nigiri ($6.00) matched exactly. Could not independently confirm current prices.
data_notes: Address (1815 S Coast Hwy, Oceanside, CA 92054) and lat/lng (33.1746, -117.3619) check out; neighborhood 'South Oceanside' is reasonable. Restaurant confirmed open, not closed. Hours: our data has Wed-Sun 4-9pm (closed Mon/Tue); web sources show Wed-Thu closing at 8:30pm rather than 9pm, a 30-min discrepancy on 2 of 5 open days, otherwise matching. Cuisine 'American'/'New American' is a generic label for what is really a sushi/omakase-focused restaurant.
issues: Menu prices could not be verified against the live Toast source (blocked); only a possibly-stale Yelp snapshot was reachable, so price accuracy is uncertain rather than confirmed wrong
